sourceText:
Asian Chicken
By: Thibeault's Table
Published: Tuesday, December 1, 2009 - 12:43am

Ingredients




1/4 cup Firmly Packed Brown Sugar
2 tablespoons Cornstarch
1/4 cup Vinegar
1 tablespoon Soy Sauce
15 ounces Pineapple Chunks, Drained
1 cup Strips, Green Pepper
1 cup Thin Onion Rings
1 tablespoon Oil
2 Boneless Chicken Breasts *

Preparation

1 * Cut into thin strips. 2 In a medium bowl, combine sugar and cornstarch. Gradually stir in vinegar and soy sauce. Stir in pineapple, green pepper and onion, set aside. Heat oil in wok. Add chicken and stir fry, just until tender, and chicken has turned white. Add pineapple and vegetable mixture; stir until well mixed. 3 Cover and simmer over low heat 15 minutes.
